messages:
Alex R: Starting thread — Omnia private rollout scheduled TOMORROW 02:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go for dedicated->private swap. Summary: version pinned to rwinf/v2.3.1, canary progression 5% -> 25% -> 100% across 1h total with pause windows. Customer requires no-downtime. Asking SRE/Oncall/Security/Product to confirm preflight items: snapshots, KMS, metrics dashboards, rollback commands, routing fallback. @Priya M @Dan O @Lina S @Jess T please ack.

DeployBot: Scheduled rollout job 89234 created by alex.r. Plan attached. ETA: 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z. Use command: `rwinf deploy --tenant omnia --model rwinf/v2.3.1 --canary 5,25,100 --schedule 02:00Z`.

Alex R: rollout plan (quick):
```
canary:
  - 5% 10m
  - 25% 20m
  - 100% 30m
rollback:
  - command: `rwinf rollback --tenant omnia --to rwinf/v2.2.9`
  - metrics: error rate > 2% sustained 5m OR p95 latency increase > 200ms
```

Priya M: SRE preflight update — storage snapshot at 01:30 UTC ✅, KV cache primed, autoscale policy bumped +20% for first 30m. Observability dashboards deployed: https://grafana.redwood/omnia (smoke checks wired). I'll run smoke at canary start and post results here.

Dan O: Oncall ack. I'll watch alerts and be ready to trigger rollback. Runbook snippet added below for quick action.
`If fail -> DM @Priya M -> run: /runbook omnia-rollback && post rollback-id`

Lina S: Security check — KMS key rotated yesterday and verified, IAM principals reviewed. No additional approvals needed from security side.

Jess T: Product: Customer PM notified and confirmed public release notes for v2.3.1 are posted: https://releases.redwood/v2.3.1. Two small model-behavior adjustments (non-breaking). Customer prefers morning window, confirmed OK.

Alex R: One ops ask — please add fallback routing to quantized variant if we hit thermal/latency issues: fallback -> rwinf/v2.3.1-quant. Can SRE add an automated fallback rule to the routing policy?

Priya M: Will do. Proposed policy: `fallback: rwinf/v2.3.1-quant if GPU_temp>80C or latency_p95>300ms for 3 consecutive samples`. I'll push rule to canary config and test in staging.

DeployBot: Job 89234 queued -> will attempt deploy at 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z. Canary slices: slice-a(5%), slice-b(25%), global(100%). Notifications: #eng-releases and #oncall. Auto-rollback hook enabled.

Dan O: Ack :thumbsup: I'll be oncall for the window. Pager contacts updated, escalation to Priya at +1.

Jess T: LGTM from product. Approve to proceed assuming preflight passes.

Alex R: Go/no-go timer: waiting on final confirmation from customer PM. If no response by 23:30 UTC we'll proceed with default go. @Jess T can you confirm when you hear back?

Jess T: Customer PM replied at 23:10 UTC — confirmed GO. :tada:

Priya M: Great. Preflight smoke will run 15m before start. I'll post pass/fail and the initial metrics snapshot 10m into each stage.

Dan O: Leaving the explicit rollback thresholds here for clarity: sustained error rate >1.5% for 5m OR token failure spike >50% => immediate rollback. I'll trigger and announce in #incidents when I do.

Alex R: Thanks all. I'll update release notes with the final canary schedule and pin the version in the rollout doc. If anything changes, post here and I'll escalate.
